_about: Kanzoo's locked looks. kanzoo-video reproduces kanzoo-monday-reel-4k-brand.mp4 exactly. The thumbnail look lives in scripts/make_thumbnail.py. All fonts are bundled in assets/fonts.

kanzoo-video.name: Kanzoo Video
kanzoo-video.mood: Matches the official thumbnail: TeX Gyre Chorus in espresso and wide-spaced Inter Medium capitals in mocha, each with a soft cream glow, on soft natural coffee light. No white text, no bars, no dark fades.
kanzoo-video.pacing: Hook title over 3 quick shots, 0.7-1.0s cuts on actions, a fast replay montage, slow quiet holds to end
kanzoo-video.label_css: color: #694330; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .42em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 500; font-size: .55em; text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(250,246,241,.55), 0 0 40px rgba(250,246,241,.3);
kanzoo-video.line_css: color: #341D13; font-family: var(--accent); font-weight: 400; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #341D13; text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(250,246,241,.55), 0 0 60px rgba(250,246,241,.35);
kanzoo-video.extra_css: .title { left: 78px; right: auto; top: 1320px; text-align: left; } .title .line { margin-left: 4px; margin-top: 5px; line-height: .86; } .tagw { font-size: 67px; margin-top: -1px; } .tag { color: #694330; } .lab { font-size: 70px; } .end { left: 78px; right: 130px; text-align: left; }
